program.title: BSc in Biomedical and Health Sciences
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 0-3, 0-1, 3-7, 3-4, 17-21).
The elective requirement varies by capstone pathway: 17 credits (opting for LIFS 4976 and LIFS 4986) or 21 credits (opting for LIFS 4966). The calculated total uses the 17-credit minimum.

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. LIFS 1901/1903 exemptions, 2-of-4 LIFS 39xx case studies, capstone alternatives, MATH block), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
Remarks in the PDF note that LIFS 3180, LIFS 3190, LIFS 4170 and LIFS 4881 are new courses subject to approval; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 BMH (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
